solutions.logisticsDesc:
We improve the operational efficiency of large warehouses and logistics facilities,

providing tailored solutions

that reduce energy costs.
solutions.factoryDesc:
With illumination optimized for manufacturing environments, we improve

work accuracy and cut unnecessary energy waste.
solutions.parkingDesc:
Tailored to parking environments with frequent vehicle and foot traffic, we optimize energy

through detection-based lighting schedules and brightness settings.
solutions.officeDesc:
Enjoy both a comfortable work environment that reduces eye strain and boosts focus

and energy savings

at the same time.

strengths.desc1:
With mesh networking and Dual-Stack technology,

we quickly connect tens of thousands of devices

into a single network.
strengths.title2: A <hl>leading company</hl> in Korea's DR field
strengths.desc2:
We built Korea's first lighting-based DR system,

turning a building's energy into

a distributed resource.
strengths.alt2: A leading company in Korea's DR field
strengths.desc3:
From IC design to hardware development, network setup,

and software operation — all developed and managed in-house

to deliver tailored solutions.
strengths.alt3: One-stop service on an integrated solution
strengths.desc4:
With only a lighting replacement and no extra wiring,

we achieve power savings and carbon reduction

at the same time.

home.srDescription: From facility environment analysis to on-site optimized energy operations, we change the paradigm of savings.
home.heroSubtitle:
By analyzing and optimizing the power consumption of countless sites,

we are building the future of energy operations together.
home.whyDesc1: MerlotLab provides energy-saving solutions with no installation cost, and charges only a portion of the electricity savings as its fee.
home.whyDesc2: Start reducing your electricity bill with no upfront burden.
home.energyBizDesc:
With the goal of reducing energy costs, the investor

covers the full initial equipment investment and recovers it through the savings.
home.pricingSubtitle: A transparent and reasonable pricing policy
home.priceNote: *These prices apply only to energy efficiency projects
home.step1Desc: We visit the site to run a baseline diagnosis and conduct a survey for a tailored design
home.step2Desc: Based on the diagnosis, we propose the optimal solution for energy savings
home.step3Desc: Through detailed discussion, we finalize the design and provide a final proposal
home.step4Desc: After signing, we build an IoT-based EMS system optimized for the site
home.step5Desc: We verify the savings and provide support for stable operation
